cards.title: NFR-3.10 response must be rewritten
cards.summary: Aiden implies BTP multi-hyperscaler support removes cloud lock-in, but SAP DM in eu20 runs on Azure only. This is a documented Must gap requiring explicit disclosure.
body: The requirement asks for multi-cloud support or a transparent risk description. Aiden says BTP is offered across multiple hyperscalers, which is technically true at the platform level but misleading: SAP DM in the eu20 region runs exclusively on Azure.

The response needs to state plainly that multi-cloud portability is not available. Mitigating factors are the contractual data export guarantee, SAP BCP commitments, and multi-AZ redundancy within Azure eu20.

content.label: Must gap
content.detail: The single biggest architectural objection in this review.

left.label: Current wording
left.value: BTP is multi-hyperscaler, so cloud lock-in is removed.

right.label: What DKG gets
right.value: SAP DM in eu20 runs exclusively on Microsoft Azure.

items.text: SAP DM runs on Microsoft Azure in the eu20 region.
DKG cannot choose or switch this workload to AWS or GCP.
Data export, BCP commitments, and multi-AZ redundancy mitigate—but do not remove—the gap.

content.label: Recommended wording
content.title: Be explicit about Azure-only hosting
content.text: SAP DM is hosted on Microsoft Azure in eu20. Multi-cloud portability is not available for this deployment. Contractual data export and multi-AZ resilience reduce exit and availability risk.

cards.title: NFR-4.04 has a factual error on S/4HANA integration
cards.summary: No middleware required is wrong. SAP CPI is the mandatory integration layer between SAP DM and S/4HANA, and NFR-4.02 in the same document states exactly that.
body: The standard SAP DM to S/4HANA integration is delivered through pre-built CPI iFlows. There is no direct middleware-free path.
Correction: CPI configuration is part of the implementation scope. No custom development is needed for the standard flows.

content.label: Factual error
content.detail: The response contradicts NFR-4.02 in the same document.

right.label: Correct
right.value: SAP CPI is the mandatory integration layer.

items.text: Pre-built CPI iFlows cover orders, BOMs, routings, confirmations, goods movements, and quality notifications.
CPI configuration belongs in the implementation scope.
No custom development is needed for these standard flows.

cards.title: 7 items need a col J remark before submission
cards.summary: Seven requirements contain unconfirmed claims or gaps that need a short qualification before the response is submitted.
body: NFR-1.05 and NFR-1.06 need security evidence narrowed or verified. NFR-2.03, NFR-3.01, NFR-3.04, and NFR-3.09 need contractual or roadmap claims qualified.
NFR-4.06 must be aligned with the fit assessment and disclosed as custom integration scope.

content.label: Remarks needed
content.detail: All seven can be resolved in col J without rewriting the full answer.

items.text: NFR-1.05 — verify ISO 27017 and 27018 in SAP Trust Center.
NFR-1.06 — narrow CIS claim to Level 1 or provide Level 2 evidence.
NFR-2.03 — verify the named AI addendum exists.
NFR-3.01 — remove or qualify uncommitted roadmap specifics.
NFR-3.04 — clarify that SAP schedules SaaS maintenance windows.
NFR-3.09 — confirm escrow with SAP commercial and legal.
NFR-4.06 — disclose Ultimo as custom PPD REST integration.

cards.action_label: Add col J remarks for 7 items

NFR-3.01, NFR-3.04, and NFR-3.09 need qualifications. NFR-3.10 is the Must gap covered in the critical card.

NFR-3.01 — qualify specific roadmap items.
NFR-3.04 — correct maintenance-window flexibility.
NFR-3.09 — confirm escrow availability.

cards.title: Interoperability NFR-4.01 through NFR-4.10
cards.summary: 7 of 10 items are clean; one response is factually wrong and two need a scope qualification.
body: NFR-4.04 incorrectly calls the S/4HANA integration middleware-free. NFR-4.05 should acknowledge the Partial fit for Qlik and Databricks.
NFR-4.06 understates the custom integration scope for Ultimo. The other seven responses are supported by the knowledge base.

items.text: NFR-4.04 — SAP CPI is mandatory for the standard S/4HANA integration.
NFR-4.05 — Qlik has no certified SAP DM connector; the fit is Partial.
NFR-4.06 — Ultimo is custom PPD REST integration scope.
